description: Connect AI clients to a caller-owned Discord bot with 192 tools over stdio or authenticated HTTP.
name: io.github.cappyeo/discord-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Discord bot token. The optional Bot prefix is accepted.
environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Expected Discord bot ID. Startup fails if the token belongs to another bot.
environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_EXPECTED_BOT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Discord guild IDs this deployment may operate against.
environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_GUILDS

title: Discord MCP
